overall_summary: Analysis of FACTVERSE performance data demonstrates that 'What If' space scenarios and extreme planetary facts (specifically regarding extreme environments, diamond/luxury planets, and bizarre cosmic properties) dominate engagement velocity and engagement-per-view. Videos published within the last 7 days such as 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and planetary fall scenarios (IYuce8vaU3Y, 8KEl0_pJ_68) show rapid growth compared to older psychological or minor biological facts. Audience retention thrives on sensory extremes, counterintuitive scales, and speculative physics framed as direct viewer experiences.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos asking 'What If You Fell Into...' or exploring bizarre planetary environments (e.g., IYuce8vaU3Y with 1,024 views and 38 likes; 8KEl0_pJ_68 with 972 views) consistently outperform standard encyclopedic facts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-stakes, hypothetical survival scenarios in extreme cosmic locations with high engagement-per-view ratios.

winning_patterns.evidence: Venus having a day longer than its year (A9Qa-RmuOr0) generated 970 views and 21 likes rapidly after launch on October 1.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form concepts featuring paradoxical time or spatial measurements that defy intuitive logic.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring vivid physical phenomena paired with bold emojis (diamonds, extreme cold/heat) drive high like-to-view ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Maintain short durations (15-21 seconds) with immediate visual setups in the first 2 seconds.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like song memory tricks (ef3ND4qiRHc, Jc04LVKNd2s) and basic brain facts (2fqaGqfsR4A) stalled below 100 views with negligible engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize abstract psychological micro-facts unless framed through an intense, high-stakes hypothetical narrative.

weak_patterns.evidence: Standard animal facts like octopus hearts (AXAfwrzzEdU) plateaued quickly past their initial launch windows compared to celestial extremes.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content away from simple trivia toward cinematic animal survival or extreme prehistoric comparisons.
